## Design

### 2026-10-07 — October 6,

**3h**

October 6,
Today I started working on the Starbie project by reading the how to make your own Starbie guide. I first downloaded the care package then I unzipped the file.

October 7,
Today, I installed KiCad and I watched youtube videos explaining how to install the symbol and footprint libraries.
Next, i started the project and added all the symbols and connected them as instructed in the guide.
